title: Father Holding Swaddled Baby, Brick Backyard - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A tender full-length outdoor portrait captures a proud father cradling his swaddled newborn baby wrapped in a fringed white blanket. Standing on the lawn beside a brick home under bright sunlight, the father is dressed in classic 1940s fashion featuring high-waisted pleated trousers, a rolled-sleeve light dress shirt, and slicked-back hair. The photograph evokes the warmth of mid-century American domestic life during the WWII or early post-war era.
